description: This file defines the `SeoUrl` class inside the `Opencart\Catalog\Model\Design` namespace. It contains methods for retrieving SEO URL data from the database based on keywords and key-value pairs, used for SEO URL management in the OpenCart system.

classes.name: SeoUrl
classes.description: Model class providing methods to retrieve SEO URL information based on keywords and key-value pairs.

methods.name: getSeoUrlByKeyword
methods.description: Retrieves SEO URL data associated with a specific keyword from the database.

methods.name: getSeoUrlByKeyValue
methods.description: Retrieves SEO URL data based on a specific key and value from the database.
